data_fields.name: reach_rule_offset
data_fields.donor_constant: +1 added to Adjacent for the ring field and pass test

data_fields.name: is_hub
data_fields.donor_constant: IsBase default true; INI key BaseNormal

best_idea: A new hub service may only be placed within a fixed short reach of an existing hub building, one completed structure is held pending at a time, and the cursor shows the same yes/no result the engine will apply.
decision_why: Gives a readable one-at-a-time growth order for hub services in a town zone; the engine must own the reach check (the donor's sim does not re-check it), the reach is zone data, and the field must be rebuilt when the hub set changes. Parity row 21 (catalogue fields) is the nearest row; no row covers town layout.
acceptance: A server test accepts a hub service next to the first hub, refuses the same service three cells away even when the client sends it (not-near-hub), refuses a second start while one is pending, and the client ghost shows the same pass/fail cells as the engine check.
